title: Users
description: System staff members and their access status

filters.search: Search by name, email or role

editRoles.title: Edit roles
editRoles.description: Select the roles assigned to this user

activate.title: Activate user
activate.description: This user will regain access to the system
activate.question: Are you sure you want to activate this user?
activate.hint: The user will be able to sign in again with their previously assigned roles.

deactivate.title: Deactivate user
deactivate.description: This user will lose access to the system
deactivate.question: Are you sure you want to deactivate this user?
deactivate.hint: No data will be deleted. The user will keep their details and roles, and you can reactivate them at any time.

roleDescriptions.Administrador: Can manage staff, roles, and access different sections of the system.
roleDescriptions.Gestor de documentación: Can manage document categories, files, and surveys.
roleDescriptions.Solicitante de traslado: Can submit new patient transport requests.
roleDescriptions.Gestor de traslados: Can manage transport requests, assign resources, and update their status.
roleDescriptions.Enfermero: Nursing staff who can accompany patient transfers.
